title: A Network Approach to Psychopathology: New Insights into Clinical Longitudinal Data
country: Belgium, The Netherlands, The Netherlands, The Netherlands
limitations: - Small sample size; - Lack of diversity in sample; - Assumptions of stationarity and equally spaced time points may not hold perfectly; - Limited generalizability due to specific population (residual depressive symptoms); - No formal test for redundancy/conceptual overlap between nodes.
notes: The paper does not mention preregistration. The code and data are declared available in the appendices. The study used a multilevel-VAR model, which is a novel approach for ESM data, but the authors did not explicitly state whether they checked for redundancy/conceptual overlap between nodes before running the network model.
